page.layout: One block of text, centred on the page: the title lines, the dedication lines, the author's line, then the printer's woodcut device, then the imprint line. No running head, page number or catchword. Two handwritten marks and show-through from the reverse are left out.

main_text.l: mo viro Dn. M. RODOLPHO GO-

page.notes: Below the author's line is a printer's woodcut device, a mask-like face with scrollwork, ribbons, tassels and foliage. It carries no text. The line "Marpurgi, typis Pauli Egenolphi. Anno 1592." is set in italic. The final syllable of "co-" at the end of the "suscipere" line is a doubtful ligature, transcribed as co-[?]. Handwriting in the top right ("N. 45"), a faint mark at the top left, and a pencil shelf mark at the bottom right are not printed text and are left out. Show-through of text from the reverse (top right, "REVR...") is left out.
